name: Obadiah Wells

burial.cemetery: Old Burial Ground (headstone beside his son Dr. Henry Wells)

updates.occupation: Pedlar, then glazier and painter in New York City; land proprietor at Brattleboro

events.title: Pedlar's licence
events.description: Paid GBP 5 for a one-year licence to trade as a pedlar (receipt signed A. De Peyster).

events.title: Marriage
events.description: Married his first wife Mary Conkling.

events.title: Brattleboro declaration
events.description: First signer of a declaration that the people of the town were loyal to the State of New York (the Vermont jurisdiction dispute), not Tories.

relationships.evidence: Hayes ch. VI: 'Obadiah Wells, second son of Henry I'

bioAdditions: Second son of Henry Wells I (b. 1690), grandson of William Wells II and Elizabeth Tuthill (Hayes, S1). He is John's 2nd cousin 9 times removed through William Wells and again through John Tuthill (1635). He left Southold at about 18, peddled under a 1735 New York licence, became a glazier and painter (also selling lottery tickets in 1749), joined the purchase of a large tract at Brattleboro, and died at Montague aged 83 years 6 months.

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Hayes 1878 gives the line from William Wells with documents (receipts, wills, gravestone).

sources.citation: Charles W. Hayes, William Wells of Southold and his Descendants (1878) (archive.org full text), ch. VI
